summary.text: Stan Lambert, a Republican from Abilene, represents Texas House District 71 and is serving his fourth term, representing Taylor, Nolan, Jones and Callahan counties. At the start of the 88th Session he was appointed vice chair of the Pensions, Investments, and Financial Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lambert was born and raised in Abilene and earned a bachelor's degree in business from Abilene Christian University in 1975, followed by a graduate certification from the Southwestern Graduate School of Banking.
He worked in community banking for more than 35 years and recently retired from Texas Heritage Bank.
In 1995 he became Athletic Director at Abilene Christian University.
He has also served as Mayor of Ennis, Texas, and as a member of the Abilene Independent School District Board of Trustees.
